column2: query
I don't have a place to stay because I escaped from my trafficker. I don't know where to start.
I am running away from my abuser, who is searching for me and my children. I do not know where I am and I am very afraid. What can I do?
I need help because I am in danger, but I do not want to go to the police because I am afraid of being deported.
I have been to 3 hospitals, but they refuse me because I am undocumented. I am in immense pain and need immediate attention. I am in Amsterdam. What do I do?
I need a doctor.
I'm homeless and looking for a shelter. I am very tired. I don't have anyone to help me.
My family and I got denied access to the shelter. We are from Ukraine and we are in Rotterdam right now. We are very tired.

I live in Utrecht and I am on the streets now because of an abusive landlord. I went to a homeless shelter with my children and they refused me because I still have my job and some saved up money, but not enough for a hotel. Now they are threatening to take my children away. Help me!
live in Utrecht, but I got kicked out of my house today. Where can I find a warm meal?
I have applied for a Dublin claim, and I have been waiting for a response for weeks now. This is incredibly frustrating. I have family here that depends on me and I feel completely stuck.
You already told me about the day shelters. I know about those. I need an actual place to sleep tonight with my children. Stop giving me the same information!

I am from Ukraine and I work in a factory. I live with my other colleagues, and my boss pays for my rent, utilities, and gives me an allowance. I want to go home this Christmas to visit my family, but he refuses because he says it's the busiest season and if I leave everyone will want to go home as well, so we will all lose our jobs. Can you help somehow?

I am from Morocco and I have been living in the Netherlands for 20 years. My doctor retired and the new practice is refusing to register me because I don't have a BSN. I know my rights, and this is incredibly frustrating. What else can I do?
I need food!
I have diabetes and I am undocumented. I need insulin but I also cannot afford the food I need for my diet. The doctor told me I need to eat differently but everything is too expensive.

I have a temporary residence permit from Portugal, but I am originally from Iraq. I moved to the Netherlands to find work, but now they are telling me I cannot work here. I don’t understand. I have European papers.

You referred me to an organisation for asylum and they told me I don’t qualify. Nobody is helping me. I have been going from place to place and everyone keeps saying the same thing. What was the point of sending me there?

I am pregnant and my landlord kicked me out because he doesn’t want a baby in the house. I need to see a doctor for my pregnancy and I also have nowhere to sleep tonight. I don’t know what to do. I am so tired of this.
wer find winter clodes. I nigeria.
I am undocumented and I have two children. They need to go to school but I am afraid to register them. Also, where can I get winter clothes for them? They are growing fast
I lost my job and got kicked out of my house because I could not pay rent. I am from Poland. I have been homeless for a couple of days, and need to shower and do laundry.
